DECISIONS:
Q1: A
Q2: A

RATIONALE:
Q1: In the repository, `tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:4661` already accepts a sign in the `CI_SUBTEST_END` check (`elapsed_ms=-?\d+`). Line 4662's heartbeat check is the only one still using `elapsed_ms=\d+`, so the two checks of the same `date +%s%3N` difference disagree. In the failing run the runner clock stepped backward, which made every heartbeat negative. The pipeline cannot rerun the job and wait to see whether it fails again, so the issue's "harden if it repeats" step falls back to the smallest safe change: edit only that one test line, change no shipped step body, and the test still requires heartbeat lines to appear. The overlap with open PRs #9057 and #9268 is a single regex token, which keeps any merge conflict trivial. Line 4669 (`elapsed_ms=\d+ rc=3`) is not part of the reported failure and stays as it is.
Q2: The issue names `.github/workflows/ci.yml` as the only cause file and says not to change unrelated machinery to make a job pass. PR #9273 did not cause the `gh_retry` closed-reader result on the uutils runner. The repository already treats it as a known runner problem: the docstring of `_closed_pipe_diagnostics` in `tests/test_gh_retry_stdout_isolation.py` (lines 246-251) describes ubuntu-26.04 Rust coreutils giving `rc=0`. Option C would weaken a safety check. Option B would change a shared helper used by every workflow, outside this triage's scope. So this issue covers only the CI wiring plus the Q1 regex, and the `gh_retry` behaviour on ubuntu-26.04 goes to a separate issue or the existing runner-breakage work.

EXECUTION PLAN (required for any non-letter decision):
Q1:
  strategy: derive_from_repo
  inputs:
    - tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py lines 4661-4662
    - .github/workflows/ci.yml step "Test-and-mark-stable plan polling guard regression tests" (line 1844, job `tests-promote-stall-and-review`)
    - tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_clarify_wait.py (exists only on the PR branch `ai/issue-9223`)
  steps:
    - In `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, add one step right after "Test-and-mark-stable plan polling guard regression tests" (line 1844), in the same job: name "Test-and-mark-stable clarify wait diagnostics tests", run `set -euo pipefail` then `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_clarify_wait.py`. If the file has no `__main__` runner and only works under pytest, use `python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider` instead. Use 2-space YAML indentation, put the step in exactly one job, and do not add the file to `UNWIRED_ALLOWLIST`.
    - In `tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py` line 4662, change `elapsed_ms=\d+\n` to `elapsed_ms=-?\d+\n`. Change nothing else in that file and do not touch the shipped step body in `ci.yml`.
    - Run `tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py`, `tests/test_ci_job_split_contract.py` and the modified sharding test locally to confirm they pass.
  replaces_acceptance_criterion: none
  equivalence_argument: none
  reversibility: Both edits are one line each. Reverting the regex restores the strict assertion, and the new CI step can be moved to another job if a human prefers.
